profile.name: Sathursan Kamalanathan
profile.headline: AI & ML Engineering Student · Full-stack Builder · Video Editor
profile.tagline: Curious engineer-in-the-making, turning bold ideas into polished, human-centered products — from national healthcare prototypes to live hackathon apps and edited reels.
profile.availability: Open to AI/ML and full-stack internships, and creative tech collaborations
about: AI & ML undergrad at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (Ramapuram), with a research-driven A-Level record — A* Mathematics, A-level passes in Further Mathematics, Physics and Accounting.
I build across the stack: fine-tuning a RoBERTa fake-news classifier in Python, shipping 40-screen TypeScript/React hackathon prototypes, and designing with Photoshop, Premiere Pro and After Effects.
I'm driven by educational innovation and AI-powered learning tools, and I bring leadership to everything I touch — school prefect, cricket captain, and video-edit club member.
My goal: build technology that is genuinely useful, honest and human.

projects.name: IndiaFlow (Nexus-AI)
projects.description: A 40-screen national healthcare intelligence prototype: consent-based patient-owned records, an AI layer (risk prediction, medication safety, emergency triage, multi-agent orchestration), security & privacy governance, and rural offline support. Built for a Smart India internal hackathon.

projects.name: AI Fake-News Credibility Analyzer
projects.description: Streamlit app that scores article credibility: RoBERTa fine-tuned classifier with an automatic lightweight fallback (TF-IDF + Logistic Regression), clickbait detection, emotional intensity and source-reputation scoring. Runs out of the box; fine-tuning script included.

projects.name: Smart Workforce Attendance Tracker
projects.description: Live hackathon-built app to log punches and tasks, with a 'Today's Attendance & Tasks' dashboard — Flask + SQLite, built and shipped in a single session.

projects.name: Employee Mood Thermometer
projects.tagline: Anonymised stress & burnout detection for teams
projects.description: Full-stack web app where employees log their daily mood and HR gets anonymized dashboards to spot stress and burnout early — React-style clean dashboard UI.

projects.name: Google-Sheets User Manager
projects.tagline: A real CRUD app where a Sheet is the database
projects.description: A minimal full-flow CRUD app: HTML form → Google Apps Script backend → Google Sheet as database → back to UI. Used to teach the entire request→persist→render path.

projects.name: Zero-to-Infinity Full-Stack Series
projects.description: A growing series of advanced full-stack builds — starting with a smart profile UI system with light/dark theme, sessionStorage persistence and real-time DOM updates.

projects.name: Mini Enterprise Lead Management System
projects.tagline: Structured lead capture for SaaS teams
projects.description: A clean HTML/JS lead-capture form with structured flow — built during the SarlaYash full-stack project hackathon.

projects.name: JARVIS-Orion Assistant
projects.description: A desktop first assistant built in Python, mixing plug-in modules (chat, automation, system tools, installer) — my companion project.

projects.name: LinkedIn Automation Suite
projects.tagline: Official-API LinkedIn posting with scheduling & AI content
projects.description: Python automation suite: OAuth integration with LinkedIn's official API (org-page posting, scheduling, analytics), a Playwright browser bot for human-like engagement, and a local-LLM/Ollama content generator. Ships with Docker Compose, PostgreSQL and Redis.

projects.name: lifeOS — Career Twin
projects.tagline: Flutter career-twin app with growth predictions
projects.description: A Flutter 'career twin' app: human growth graph and prediction engine, skill graphs per profession, career-path ontology, opportunity matching (internships, hackathons, scholarships) and AI memory system — backed by datasets and research docs.
highlights: 12 career paths with skill graphs and opportunities data

projects.name: AI Diagnosis App
projects.description: A healthcare diagnosis hackathon prototype: NX + TypeScript monorepo with an OpenAPI spec, shared API client, artifact apps and a patient-facing mockup, plus backend packaged as a zip.

projects.name: Live Portfolio & CV Agent
projects.description: CLARA: a Next.js portfolio generated entirely from a single verified profile.json, with snapshot scripts (GitHub, personal docs, project folders), validation, and per-role one-page CV builder (HTML + PDF).
highlights: Role-specific CVs built from job descriptions

projects.name: Song Guessing Game
projects.tagline: Browser music-guessing game with a Node server
projects.description: A web-based song guessing game — HTML/CSS/JS front end, Node.js server, testable game logic and a future-features folder.
